intended_object: The natural embedding y ↦ (0, y) of the second even lattice M into the overlattice of L ⊥ M obtained by gluing along an anti-isometry of discriminant forms (Nikulin, Prop. 1.6.1). This comes from the docstring and the module documentation.
explanation: The body takes the inclusion M.carrier → W, composes it with `LinearMap.inr : W → V × W` (which sends y to (0, y)), and restricts the codomain to the glued lattice. The restriction is justified by `mem_glueAlongDiscriminant_right_iff`: the glued lattice contains (0, y) exactly when y ∈ M. The library also proves `coe_glueRight_apply`, which states that the image of y is (0, y). So the map is the standard ℤ-linear inclusion of M into the glued unimodular overlattice. It matches its docstring and the inclusion used in primitive-embedding arguments. The hypotheses (both lattices even and nondegenerate, and an isometry from the discriminant form of L to the negated discriminant form of M) are the ones the gluing construction itself needs, so the definition is not too narrow. Mathlib has no gluing of lattices along discriminant forms, so there is no Mathlib counterpart.
